metric_semantics.recomputed_node_count: Actual recomputation count. Remains zero for benchmark adapters that do not execute real node/task recomputation.
metric_semantics.simulated_recomputed_node_count: Number of benchmark-level simulated recomputation invocations; not evidence of real task execution.
metric_semantics.task_success: Unknown/null when the scenario contains no executable task payload and verified expected output.
metric_semantics.recovery_success: Unknown/null unless recovery is semantically executed and verified.
metric_semantics.recovery_execution_success: Success of the benchmark-level simulation only when the adapter labels its recovery execution mode as benchmark_simulation.
metric_semantics.elapsed_seconds: Adapter execution time, not end-to-end agent runtime.

interpretation_warning: Strategies have different policies. Compare metric semantics, not just raw values. BeliefGraph's simulated recomputation is reported separately from actual recomputation; simulated success is not semantic task success.

details.metric_note: Baseline does not perform dependency-aware impact analysis or selective recovery. Strategy-level affected and preserved counts therefore remain zero; the formal ground-truth regions are reported separately.
